caption: The drawing depicts a full-length dress prominently in the center-left, featuring a fitted bodice with a high neckline and long sleeves. The dress is composed of alternating vertical blue, beige, and black stripes, and includes wide blue and yellow bands with a detailed pattern at the sleeves’ elbows and around the waist, adding contrast. The skirt is voluminous and follows the same striped pattern. Adjacent to this colored rendering, on the right side of the drawing, is an uncolored, sketched version of the same dress, showing the outlines and structure without the filled-in colors or patterns. The background of the image is a plain, light beige or off-white.
title: Blue & Grey Striped Dress
